plain: Scoring one user across many tasks and many tries, so a fact counts as leaked if it slips out even once anywhere.
eli5: If a friend keeps your secret all year, one slip on one day is enough for it to be out.
technical: CIMemories' second evaluation knob: run each profile through K tasks with T samples each and take the per-attribute maximum, so Violation@n can only rise with K and T; for GPT-5 it goes from 0.1% (one task) to 9.6% (40 tasks) to 25.1% (40 tasks, 5 samples each) (Fig 2).
